verdict.rationale: Store Sync is PayPal's own documented path for making a merchant's full product catalog discoverable by AI shopping assistants, with catalog on-ramps through partners such as Wix, Feedonomics/BigCommerce, Cymbio and Shopware. However, the pack never shows the feed format or catalog import API itself; the only crawled API surface is the merchant-hosted cart endpoints. Access is also form-gated and limited to US physical goods in USD. Missing for 10: a documented first-party feed or import API spec (schema, endpoints, sync cadence), self-serve access, support beyond US physical goods, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent discovery.
